items.title: AWS PrivateLink endpoints are now available on Secure Compute
items.summary: Enterprise teams using  can now create and manage  endpoints directly from the Vercel dashboard.Secure ComputeAWS PrivateLinkEndpoints on Secure Compute live in your team's dedicated VPC and use the network's AWS region. They belong to the network and are shared by its connected project environments., , and builds connected to the network can reach AWS-hosted backends over the AWS private network. Before you add an endpoint in Vercel, the backend must already be exposed through a published AWS PrivateLink endpoint service. Examples include RDS, Aurora, Redshift, Snowflake, MongoDB Atlas, and internal services behind a Network Load Balancer.Vercel FunctionsVercel SandboxIn Team Settings → , open your Secure Compute network and choose  from the  tab.NetworkingAdd EndpointPrivateLinkStandard pricing for new endpoints:Read the  to get started.Secure Compute PrivateLink documentationRead moreEach Secure Compute network includes one AWS PrivateLink endpoint. Additional endpoints cost $30 per month each.PrivateLink data transfer costs $0.04 per GB.
